text:
Maria (PM): quick sync request — we need to prioritize enterprise compliance work for next two quarters: audit log retention, BYOK/KMS EU support, SOC2 evidence pack and retention UI. customers pushing for 7y retention and ability to hand off keys. thoughts?
Akshay (Security): +1. key asks: BYOK w/ envelope encryption, per-tenant KMS support (AWS/GCP/Azure), and proof of key separation. also need retention immutability and tamper-evidence for audits. :lock:
Lee (Platform): technical constraints: long retention = storage + search cost. we can tier to cold archive (S3 Glacier / object lock) but search/quick export needs indexing cost. BYOK requires KMS integration and key-wrapping in runtime path — adds latency unless we cache DEKs.
Sarah (Legal): from a compliance contract POV: customers ask for configurable retention and legal-hold flags. exportability in plaintext for eDiscovery is required in some contracts. need clear SLA on export timelines. also ISO/SOC2 evidence must include access logs and key management policies.
Jordan (SRE): ops concerns: supporting 7y retention across regions => lifecycle policies, cross-region replication, and backup/restore testing. also retention deletion needs safe-guards (double confirm + audit trail). we should add automation tests for restore + export workflows.
Maria (PM): proposal for prioritization (MVP vs later):
- MVP (M1, next 8w): BYOK basic integration (AWS KMS and GCP KMS), per-tenant key binding, and short-term retention config (90/365 days) + export API for ops. include docs + onboarding checklist.
- M2 (quarter 2): retention UI (per-tenant policy), legal-hold toggle, immutable archive option (append-only + object lock), EU region KMS + key residency.
- M3 (quarter 3+): long-term retention options (3–7y), searchable cold archives, SOC2/ISO evidence packaging automation, tenant-level retention SLAs and billing.
Akshay (Security): sounds reasonable. must add launch criteria per release: automated key rotation policy, KMS audit logs enabled, threat model review signed off, and encryption keys not exportable from customer KMS.
Sarah (Legal): add to launch checklist: customer-facing contract language for retention limits, a runbook for legal hold requests, and evidence format spec (CSV + hashed tokens).
Lee (Platform): technical acceptance criteria:
```
- BYOK: integrate KMS sign/encrypt for DEK; cached DEK TTL=60s
- Retention: policy stored in config DB, lifecycle job moves objects to cold after threshold
- Export API: streaming export + manifest with checksums
```
Maria (PM): cost tradeoffs — we should offer "archival add-on" for >1y retention to cover storage/index costs. pricing + billing teams pls weigh in.
Jordan (SRE): operational runbooks: incident playbook for key access loss, test plan for restore from cold, and alerting on failed exports. also add Canary for KMS integration.
Akshay (Security): one more: for BYOK onboarding we need proof-of-possession flow docs and a verification step that customer-owned keys are used (KMS key id + signed challenge).
Maria (PM): action items:
- Akshay: write BYOK security requirements and POD for onboarding (due EOD Thu)
- Lee: spike on caching DEKs and export performance (2w)
- Jordan: draft runbooks for long-term archive restore and export SLA (1w)
- Sarah: contract templates for retention/legal-hold (1w)
- Maria: pricing proposal for archival add-on and M1/M2 roadmap doc (1w)
Everyone: please react with :thumbsup: if you can take these or reply with blockers. planning sync Friday 11am PT.
DeployBot: scheduled meeting created: "Compliance roadmap prioritization" Fri 11:00 PT — link: https://meet.redwood.internal/abc123
Sarah (Legal): :thumbsup: I can cover contract templates.
Lee (Platform): :thumbsup: will start the DEK caching spike.
Akshay (Security): will draft BYOK reqs, but need input on HSM/KMS supported list. cc @Maria (PM).
Jordan (SRE): flagged a potential risk: some customers require immutable retention beyond our object-store guarantees; we may need WORM + attestations — adding to M2 scope.
Maria (PM): noted. if anyone has customer examples (SOWs) that specify retention/attestation, drop them in this thread.
Akshay (Security): sample retention config we discussed:
```
retention_policy:
  default: 90d
  enterprise: 7y
  legal_hold: true
  archive_tier: glacier
```
Maria (PM): thanks. will collect all docs and push an initial spec doc for review before Fri. :eyes:
